name: Allée du Quotidien — étape 13 · arracher, barrer, redescendre
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (gardener pulling out a giant weed, police officer lowering a striped barrier, chauffeur warming his hands at a stove on the balcony, man pasting up a fish poster at the upper window, fireman pouring sand on a burning straw hut on the roof terrace), -ir/-re RIGHT (ginger cat climbing back down the lamppost). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
